name: Mindbody
description: Mindbody is business-management software for fitness, beauty, and wellness organizations. Businesses use it to manage schedules, classes, appointments, clients, staff, memberships, sales, payments, payroll, and online booking.
agentUseSummary: Add an approved customer-owned Mindbody developer API key, activated site ID, and staff user token, then choose which agents can use the complete current Public API business surface under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: MINDBODY_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Mindbody API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create this in the customer's approved Mindbody Developer Portal account. API usage and billing remain with that account.

credentialRequirements.name: MINDBODY_SITE_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Mindbody site ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the activated business site ID. Use -99 only for Mindbody's developer sandbox.

credentialRequirements.name: MINDBODY_STAFF_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Mindbody staff token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Provide a staff user token with the permissions needed for the selected business operations. This is not the staff member's password.

capabilities.label: Read Mindbody business data
capabilities.description: Read the complete current Public API V6 surface for sites, scheduling, classes, appointments, clients, staff, enrollments, payroll, sales, products, services, and Pick a Spot.

capabilities.label: Manage Mindbody business data
capabilities.description: Run every current Public API V6 business mutation for schedules, appointments, classes, clients, staff, enrollments, sales, products, services, and reservations.

allowed.label: Read Mindbody
allowed.description: Run one bounded GET operation from Mindbody's complete current Public API V6 business surface.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Mindbody
approvalRequired.description: Run one documented Public API V6 mutation for the activated Mindbody site.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: The customer-owned API key and staff token never enter agent-visible requests or results.

blocked.label: Use another API origin
blocked.description: Every request stays on Mindbody's documented Public API origin and V6 path.

blocked.label: Call another endpoint
blocked.description: Relay permits only the 145 current business operations in the official Public API SDK; user-token issuance, renewal, and revocation remain connection lifecycle operations.

blocked.label: Run an unbounded transfer
blocked.description: Relay bounds query fields, request bodies, responses, redirects, nesting, and execution time.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Documented GET operations run directly. Every class, appointment, client, staff, enrollment, sale, product, service, schedule, or reservation mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every documented business operation authorized by the connected Mindbody staff token runs without Relay per-action approval. Provider-granted site authority, exact routes, bounds, credential protection, provider limits, billing, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts all 145 current Public API V6 business operations through fixed-origin, default-site-aware, bounded tools while keeping authentication lifecycle out of agent control.
Railway mounts all 145 current Public API V6 business operations through fixed-origin, default-site-aware, bounded tools while keeping authentication lifecycle out of agent control.

providerSetup.blocker: Mindbody requires a developer account, go-live review, site-specific activation, and developer-billed API usage. No approved customer-owned developer account, activated site, API key, staff token, representative data, or authorized live test account is available.
providerSetup.nextAction: The customer must create a Mindbody developer account, test in the sandbox, request go-live approval, activate the target business site, and connect its API key, default site ID, and staff token. Then verify default and provider-authorized site selection, reads, Safe approval, Dangerous mutations, redaction, credential rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Mindbody's current Public API V6 onboarding requires a developer account, sandbox testing, go-live review, site-specific activation, API-key authentication, and staff authorization for protected business operations.
Mindbody publishes developer-billed site-access pricing, a free sandbox and low-volume allowance, and the requirement to request production credentials and launch approval.
Mindbody identifies Public API V6 as current, documents June 2026 changes, and links the current authentication and endpoint documentation.
Mindbody's official generated Public API SDK enumerates 148 V6 operations: 145 business operations plus three staff-token lifecycle operations reserved to the connection boundary.
